depiction.primary_object: rounded square split diagonally into black and white triangles
modifiers: plus sign in upper-left black triangle
minus sign in lower-right white triangle
depiction.composition: single square glyph divided diagonally from bottom-left to top-right

readings.meaning: pros and cons / advantages and disadvantages

ambiguity: Standard photography symbol for exposure compensation, but outside photography most people read the plus/minus split as pros and cons, trade-offs, or basic arithmetic.
task_intents: write a pros and cons list
correct photo exposure in editing software

reasoning: Literally the standard photography icon for exposure compensation (+/- EV), it is also widely read by general users as pros and cons, trade-offs, or plus/minus arithmetic. It works well for photo-editing tasks, decision-making pros/cons lists, and basic math practice, though it can be confused with a simplified calculator icon.
